structs: kumwe_engine_v1_view: naturally aligned 24 bytes on supported 64-bit targets; struct_size 24..4096 and ABI 1.

opaque_handles.name: kumwe_engine_v1_buffer
opaque_handles.ownership: Unique Engine-allocated immutable result; release consumes/nulls owner slot. Caller owns input and initializes output null. Foreign/copied/dangling handles are forbidden.
opaque_handles.thread_safety: Independent calls and live immutable reads are reentrant; release/access must not race.

opaque_handles.name: kumwe_engine_v1_plan
opaque_handles.ownership: Unique immutable plan; owns normalized source independently from compile input.
opaque_handles.thread_safety: Concurrent execution allowed; no release/use race.

opaque_handles.name: kumwe_engine_v1_cancellation
opaque_handles.ownership: Unique sticky cancellation token, alive until every borrowing execution returns.
opaque_handles.thread_safety: Request may race execution; release may not race use.

limits_and_errors: Precision 1..65, scale 0..precision, literal at most 68 bytes.
Input/output at most 1 MiB; count 1..4096; deterministic work 1..1000000000 logical units.
Each row costs 512, plus 4356 for multiplication before arithmetic; atomic refusal produces no partial batch.

pull_request.title: Correct native handoff and qualify Reporting for Engine 1.0.2
pull_request.body:
Independent native adoption verification found that the published handoff substituted release prose for its required candidate attestation schema identifier. This restores that exact schema field and records the genuinely passing Reporting 0.1.3 receipt from SDK run 34515947985. The receipt matches every previously frozen source, archive, public API, service map and corpus digest. All five semantic owners are now independently verified.

Released source changes declare Engine 1.0.2 through the existing version helper, including updated handoff manifest hashes. The full handoff schema and exact Reporting receipt validation pass locally; the unchanged native quality matrix runs on this PR and again after rebase merge. Native algorithms, ABI, and original published releases are unchanged.

Merge only after the binding handoff correction has landed, so the automatic Engine sync starts from a reviewed, schema-valid binding parent.
